title: Check a plan against every rule, without the model

blocks.text: Milestone 2's solver hands back a plan, and the planning team will not take the solver's word that it is valid: a wrong row would approve its own plan. You write the checker that reads only the practice snapshot and the plan, with no model and no solver, and names every row the plan breaks. Milestone 5's properties will call it on hundreds of plans.

A plan is `{project id: start year}`. Project $`j`$ started in year $`t`$ spends `cost[k]` in year $`t + k`$ and keeps its `crews` crew-months busy in each of those years; years past the horizon are not counted. A region's floor is met by the whole cost (`sum(cost)`) of its funded projects.

rows: `{year: $k}` for every year of the horizon
the sorted names of every broken row, `[]` for a valid plan
J1 is must-do and not in the plan
two or more projects of group G1 are in the plan
J2 starts in 2028 and its parent is not in the plan, or started later than 2028 minus J2's lag
the plan spends more than the 2028 budget
the plan's South projects spend more than South's 2028 budget
the `lines` projects at work in 2028 need more crew-months than 2028 has
the whole cost of the funded North projects is below North's floor

blocks.text: A limit equal to the use is met. A region missing from `region_budget`, a program missing from `crews` and a region missing from `floor` have no limit of that kind: no row, so nothing to break. About forty lines.

            "region_budget": {"North": {2027: 100, 2028: 100}}, "crews": {"lines": {2027: 1, 2028: 1}},
            "floor": {"North": 0},
            "projects": {"J1": {"program": "lines", "region": "North", "cost": [80, 40], "earliest": 2027,

cases.says: an allowed plan breaks nothing; a plan without its must-do, one with two alternatives, one over a region's budget and one outside a window each name exactly the rows they break
a child with a one-year lag may start the year after its parent, not the same year
a child funded without its parent breaks its precedence row
a two-year project's second-year cost counts against the second year's budget
spending exactly the budget is allowed; one more project over it is not
a two-year project keeps its crews in its second year
a region's floor counts each funded project's whole cost, not its first year
a region or program the snapshot gives no limit has no row, so its spend breaks nothing
